overviewDescription: Read, route, review, and respond to customer conversations with a clear human handoff.
inboxDescription: Keep comments and private messages in one workspace-scoped queue.
commentsDescription: Browse imported public comments. Open a conversation to review the latest message and reply when delivery is enabled.
reviewsDescription: Approve response drafts only when the reason, source, and policy are clear.
automationsDescription: Control every rule, limit, and emergency stop before anything can send.
playbooksDescription: Keep approved answers current, owned, and easy to audit.
testLabDescription: Simulate decisions without contacting a customer or provider.
testLabScenarioHint: Optional context for the reviewer; customer text remains untrusted.
testLabMessagePlaceholder: Paste a customer message to simulate…
testLabScenarioPlaceholder: For example: refund request, safety concern, or product question
testLabNoProviderGuarantee: Simulation only — no provider action, message, or automation rule can be sent from this lab.
testLabInputRequired: Enter a customer message before running the simulation.
testLabProviderUnavailable: The AI provider is not configured for this agency.
analyticsDescription: Measure service load, response speed, quality, and delivery reliability.
connectionsDescription: Analytics access does not imply messaging access. Validate each operation separately.
teamDescription: Give every queue a clear owner, permission boundary, and service target.
settingsDescription: Choose the operating mode, retention, provider checks, and safety controls.
activityDescription: Trace decisions and delivery outcomes without exposing provider secrets.
setupDescription: Connect accounts, validate capabilities, and activate the workspace deliberately.
noDataDescription: Connect a supported account and run a capability check to begin collecting workspace-scoped conversations.
setupRequiredDescription: An agency administrator must enable the module and a workspace manager must activate this workspace.
moduleUnavailable: Community & Inbox is not available for this agency plan.
illustrative: Values are derived from recorded events; empty values are shown until the first validated sync.
simulationOnly: Simulation only — nothing will be sent.
noProviderActions: Provider actions are unavailable until the connection capability is validated.
validationSuccess: Capability validation completed. Each operation is enabled only where Meta confirmed the required access.
validationFailed: Capability validation could not be completed. Provider actions remain paused.
privateSyncSuccess: Private-message sync completed. New conversations are now in the inbox.
syncSuccess: Comment sync completed. New items are now in the inbox.
syncFailure: Comment sync could not be completed. Provider actions remain paused.
syncError: The last sync failed; no new provider action was sent.
replyFailure: Reply was not sent. Check the connection and delivery activity.
alreadyReplied: Meta already replied to this conversation. No additional reply was sent.
replyUnavailable: Replying is unavailable until the workspace, capability, and safety checks pass.
inboxLoadedDescription: Comments and private messages imported from validated Meta connections.
capabilityDetailMutationUat: Reply sending remains disabled until a controlled Meta test confirms the exact account and permission path.
capabilityDetailMissingScope: Required Meta permission(s): {scopes}. Enable and approve them for this app, reconnect Meta, then validate again.
capabilityDetailReadNotImplemented: Private-message import is not implemented for this connection yet.
capabilityDetailWebhooks: Polling is active; webhook delivery will be enabled after operational setup and UAT.
capabilityDetailMediaContext: Media context enrichment is not implemented for this connection yet.
capabilityDetailConversationHistory: Conversation history expansion is not implemented for this connection yet.
errorDescription: Try again or return to the Community & Inbox overview. Provider actions remain paused until the connection is healthy.
activityReplyUnknown: Reply delivery is unconfirmed. Check with an operator before retrying.
testLabAiDisabled: Community reply drafts are disabled. Ask an agency administrator to enable them in Agency Settings → AI configuration.
testLabNotInPlan: Your agency plan does not include Community reply drafts. Contact your agency administrator.
testLabRateLimited: Too many AI requests. Wait a moment and try again.
testLabQuotaExceeded: The agency AI budget has been reached. Ask an administrator to review AI usage.
testLabFailed: The simulation could not run. Try again; if it continues, contact an administrator. No reply was sent.
inboxWindow: Search and filters cover the latest 25 conversations in the current sync window.
replyPaused: Outgoing replies are paused by the emergency stop. An operator must complete safety checks before enabling delivery.
replySafetyReady: Emergency stop is inactive. Replies still require validated provider permissions.
